description:
Run Synapse SQL that may combine several tables and views, such as the SQL of a SqlWorksheet, and get its first rows. The SQL follows the rules of a materialized view's definingSQL, so it may JOIN or UNION tables and views. Nothing is saved: no entity is created, no dependency is recorded, and the result is built for this request only and then discarded.

The caller must be able to read every table and view the SQL names, with row-level access: a source the caller may only see in aggregate cannot be used here. Rows that come from a view are limited to the ones the caller can read.

limit.description: The most rows to return, from 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.
